source.title: 2026 UDK Expert List: Breakouts
source.author: Fantasy Footballers
source.summary: Ten players with role, efficiency or second-year breakout cases.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Dart's rushing production and John Harbaugh's arrival create a difference-making sophomore ceiling.
takeaways.rationale: Dart's rushing production and John Harbaugh's arrival create a difference-making sophomore ceiling.
risks: His aggressive running style creates substantial injury risk.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: A QB4 finish, strong late run and valuable rushing production support another leap in Liam Coen's offense.
takeaways.rationale: A QB4 finish, strong late run and valuable rushing production support another leap in Liam Coen's offense.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: A healthy line and Mike McDaniel's scheme set Hampton up for a true workhorse role.
takeaways.rationale: A healthy line and Mike McDaniel's scheme set Hampton up for a true workhorse role.
risks: Keaton Mitchell can siphon explosive and receiving work.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Kansas City's large investment and empty depth chart create a path for the offense to run through Walker.
takeaways.rationale: Kansas City's large investment and empty depth chart create a path for the offense to run through Walker.
risks: His career workload and receiving volume have been inconsistent.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Etienne's departure and Tuten's goal-line efficiency create RB1 upside in an attractive offense.
takeaways.rationale: Etienne's departure and Tuten's goal-line efficiency create RB1 upside in an attractive offense.
risks: Other backs can split power and receiving duties.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Elite per-route production and reduced receiver competition give Watson a strong WR3-or-better ceiling.
takeaways.rationale: Elite per-route production and reduced receiver competition give Watson a strong WR3-or-better ceiling.
risks: His injury history and Green Bay's spread offense remain concerns.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Fourth-overall draft capital and a sparse Tennessee depth chart create immediate alpha-receiver opportunity.
takeaways.rationale: Fourth-overall draft capital and a sparse Tennessee depth chart create immediate alpha-receiver opportunity.
risks: The ceiling depends on Cam Ward making a meaningful leap.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: A 25% rookie target share and little new competition position McMillan for a classic Year 2 leap.
takeaways.rationale: A 25% rookie target share and little new competition position McMillan for a classic Year 2 leap.
risks: Bryce Young and touchdown growth must cooperate.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: A dominant late-season target surge and Caleb Williams' trust create elite tight-end upside.
takeaways.rationale: A dominant late-season target surge and Caleb Williams' trust create elite tight-end upside.
risks: Chicago still has several strong target earners.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: David Njoku's departure opens enough work for Fannin to build on a dominant late-season run.
takeaways.rationale: David Njoku's departure opens enough work for Fannin to build on a dominant late-season run.
risks: Cleveland's quarterback situation limits the floor.
